supersedes: harvest-weights-v1.json (v1 per-crop-type stub — retained for reference; v2 is the authoring source of record)
status: AUTHORING — by_cultivar_samples is populated as Dave weighs (started 2026-07-30 evening harvest). Empty/null until measured.
contract: Per-VARIETY (cultivar) append-only measurement LOG + per-crop-type fallback defaults. Each sample stores RAW total_grams + unit_count (NOT a pre-divided ratio) so the derived grams_per_unit is auditable, re-derivable, and count-weighted. Append every measurement Dave reports — never dedup/overwrite, even repeats; corrections are appended (see corrections), never edits. Derived grams_per_unit = SUM(total_grams)/SUM(unit_count) per (cultivar,unit), count-weighted, over non-voided samples; confidence from dispersion (CV); min-n>=2 total unit_count-bearing samples to emit a cultivar estimate into cross-season aggregates (n=1 = provisional, excluded from comparison). NEVER a guessed factor: a variety with <min-n samples AND variety_grams_required=true yields NO estimate (NULL), never a crop-type substitute — a wrong number silently corrupts multi-season yield comparison, so NULL beats a guess. Estimated grams are computed ON-READ from this data; only genuinely MEASURED harvests (unit g/kg/lb/oz) store a weight in the app.
seed_note: A seed generator resolves each (crop_type_slug, variety_name) to a live cultivar_id FAIL-CLOSED — 0 matches OR >1 match => skip + coverage-report, NEVER pick-first (a wrong cultivar_id corrupts the integrity invariant). It emits cal1-cultivar-keys.lock.json (human key -> resolved cultivar_id) and the seed SQL, and is BATCH-idempotent via seed_batch (re-running does not double-insert). TONIGHT'S WEIGHING GOES HERE (by_cultivar_samples rows), not app harvest-logging.
grams_note: total_grams is in GRAMS. Scale reads oz/lb? convert: 1 oz = 28.3495 g, 1 lb = 453.592 g. Record the total weight of unit_count items weighed together (e.g. 12 fruit on the scale together => total_grams 220, unit_count 12). This preserves the raw numerator+denominator so the estimate is count-weighted and auditable.

sample_field_contract.crop_type_slug: crop_types.slug (from the live join). Fallback tier + coverage grouping.
sample_field_contract.variety_name: the cultivar display_name; resolved to cultivar_id at seed (fail-closed on 0 or >1 match).
sample_field_contract.unit: the harvest unit this sample calibrates — must be one of units[] and match how the crop is logged.
sample_field_contract.total_grams: measured total grams of unit_count items (>0).
sample_field_contract.unit_count: how many units were on the scale for total_grams (>0).
sample_field_contract.seed_batch: batch id for idempotent re-seed (e.g. '20260730-evening'). Optional at authoring; set at seed.
sample_field_contract.note: context (fruit size, pack density for cup, ripeness, etc.).

corrections_note: To fix a mis-typed sample: do NOT edit or delete it. Append a matching entry to by_cultivar_voids referencing the bad sample's (crop_type_slug, variety_name, sampled_at, total_grams) + reason, and (optionally) append a corrected sample. The derived view anti-joins voids. Preserves the append-only audit trail.
crop_class_guidance: Per-variety estimation earns its complexity for COUNT-of-discrete-fruit (tomato/pepper/tomatillo/cucumber/squash) where cherry vs beefsteak diverge 15g<->300g+ — per-variety REQUIRED there. For volume-RIGID fruit (berries by cup) a cup normalizes size, so per-crop nearly suffices (variety_grams_required=false, flagged crop-type fallback OK). For PACK-variable (leafy/herb by cup) and CONDITION-variable (head/bunch), grams-per-unit is an operator/season variable, NOT a cultivar constant -> PREFER DIRECT WEIGHING (log the harvest itself in grams); estimation there is low-reliability.

tomato.notes: 76 rows. HIGH variance (cherry ~15-20g / slicer ~150g / beefsteak ~300g+) -> per-variety REQUIRED, no crop-type fallback. Paste/sauce cultivars may prefer default_unit=g (used by weight).

squash.notes: 30 rows. Summer vs winter differ hugely -> per-variety.

blueberry.notes: 23 rows. Volume-rigid; a cup ~140-150g varies little by variety -> flagged crop-type fallback acceptable.

cucumber.notes: 14 rows. Slicing vs pickling differ -> per-variety.

pepper.notes: 13 rows. Bell ~120-150g vs small hot a few g -> per-variety REQUIRED (Ristra Cayenne != Chili Red).

basil.notes: 7 rows. PACK-variable -> PREFER DIRECT WEIGHING; cup estimate low-reliability.

broccoli.notes: 2 rows. CONDITION-variable -> prefer direct weighing (weigh the head).
